en.text: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

footnotes.text: 41:1 Leviathan is a name for a crocodile or similar creature.

zhSimplified.text: 你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼吗？ 能用绳子压下它的舌头吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你能用魚鉤釣上鱷魚嗎？ 能用繩子壓下牠的舌頭嗎？

en.text: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

zhSimplified.text: 你能用绳索穿它的鼻子吗？ 能用钩穿它的腮骨吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你能用繩索穿牠的鼻子嗎？ 能用鉤穿牠的腮骨嗎？

en.text: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

zhSimplified.text: 它岂向你连连恳求， 说柔和的话吗？

zhTraditional.text: 牠豈向你連連懇求， 說柔和的話嗎？

en.text: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

zhSimplified.text: 岂肯与你立约， 使你拿它永远作奴仆吗？

zhTraditional.text: 豈肯與你立約， 使你拿牠永遠作奴僕嗎？

en.text: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

zhSimplified.text: 你岂可拿它当雀鸟玩耍吗？ 岂可为你的幼女将它拴住吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你豈可拿牠當雀鳥玩耍嗎？ 豈可為你的幼女將牠拴住嗎？

en.text: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

zhSimplified.text: 搭伙的渔夫岂可拿它当货物吗？ 能把它分给商人吗？

zhTraditional.text: 搭夥的漁夫豈可拿牠當貨物嗎？ 能把牠分給商人嗎？

en.text: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

zhSimplified.text: 你能用倒钩枪扎满它的皮， 能用鱼叉叉满它的头吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你能用倒鉤槍扎滿牠的皮， 能用魚叉叉滿牠的頭嗎？

en.text: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

zhSimplified.text: 你按手在它身上，想与它争战， 就不再这样行吧！

zhTraditional.text: 你按手在牠身上，想與牠爭戰， 就不再這樣行吧！

en.text: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

zhSimplified.text: 人指望捉拿它是徒然的； 一见它，岂不丧胆吗？

zhTraditional.text: 人指望捉拿牠是徒然的； 一見牠，豈不喪膽嗎？

en.text: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

zhSimplified.text: 没有那么凶猛的人敢惹它。 这样，谁能在我面前站立得住呢？

zhTraditional.text: 沒有那麼兇猛的人敢惹牠。 這樣，誰能在我面前站立得住呢？

en.text: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

zhSimplified.text: 谁先给我什么，使我偿还呢？ 天下万物都是我的。

zhTraditional.text: 誰先給我甚麼，使我償還呢？ 天下萬物都是我的。

en.text: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

zhSimplified.text: 论到鳄鱼的肢体和其大力，并美好的骨骼， 我不能缄默不言。

zhTraditional.text: 論到鱷魚的肢體和其大力，並美好的骨骼， 我不能緘默不言。

en.text: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

zhSimplified.text: 谁能剥它的外衣？ 谁能进它上下牙骨之间呢？

zhTraditional.text: 誰能剝牠的外衣？ 誰能進牠上下牙骨之間呢？

en.text: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

zhSimplified.text: 谁能开它的腮颊？ 它牙齿四围是可畏的。

zhTraditional.text: 誰能開牠的腮頰？ 牠牙齒四圍是可畏的。

en.text: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

zhSimplified.text: 它以坚固的鳞甲为可夸， 紧紧合闭，封得严密。

zhTraditional.text: 牠以堅固的鱗甲為可誇， 緊緊合閉，封得嚴密。

en.text: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

zhSimplified.text: 这鳞甲一一相连， 甚至气不得透入其间，

zhTraditional.text: 這鱗甲一一相連， 甚至氣不得透入其間，

en.text: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

zhSimplified.text: 都是互相联络、胶结， 不能分离。

zhTraditional.text: 都是互相聯絡、膠結， 不能分離。

en.text: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

zhSimplified.text: 它打喷嚏就发出光来； 它眼睛好像早晨的光线。

zhTraditional.text: 牠打噴嚏就發出光來； 牠眼睛好像早晨的光線。

en.text: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

zhSimplified.text: 从它口中发出烧着的火把， 与飞迸的火星；

zhTraditional.text: 從牠口中發出燒着的火把， 與飛迸的火星；

en.text: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

zhSimplified.text: 从它鼻孔冒出烟来， 如烧开的锅和点着的芦苇。

zhTraditional.text: 從牠鼻孔冒出煙來， 如燒開的鍋和點着的蘆葦。

en.text: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 它的气点着煤炭， 有火焰从它口中发出。

zhTraditional.text: 牠的氣點着煤炭， 有火焰從牠口中發出。

en.text: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

zhSimplified.text: 它颈项中存着劲力； 在它面前的都恐吓蹦跳。

zhTraditional.text: 牠頸項中存着勁力； 在牠面前的都恐嚇蹦跳。

en.text: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

zhSimplified.text: 它的肉块互相联络， 紧贴其身，不能摇动。

zhTraditional.text: 牠的肉塊互相聯絡， 緊貼其身，不能搖動。

en.text: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

zhSimplified.text: 它的心结实如石头， 如下磨石那样结实。

zhTraditional.text: 牠的心結實如石頭， 如下磨石那樣結實。

en.text: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

zhSimplified.text: 它一起来，勇士都惊恐， 心里慌乱，便都昏迷。

zhTraditional.text: 牠一起來，勇士都驚恐， 心裏慌亂，便都昏迷。

en.text: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

zhSimplified.text: 人若用刀，用枪，用标枪， 用尖枪扎它，都是无用。

zhTraditional.text: 人若用刀，用槍，用標槍， 用尖槍扎牠，都是無用。

en.text: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

zhSimplified.text: 它以铁为干草， 以铜为烂木。

zhTraditional.text: 牠以鐵為乾草， 以銅為爛木。

en.text: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

zhSimplified.text: 箭不能恐吓它使它逃避； 弹石在它看为碎秸。

zhTraditional.text: 箭不能恐嚇牠使牠逃避； 彈石在牠看為碎稭。

en.text: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

zhSimplified.text: 棍棒算为禾秸； 它嗤笑短枪飕的响声。

zhTraditional.text: 棍棒算為禾稭； 牠嗤笑短槍颼的響聲。

en.text: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

zhSimplified.text: 它肚腹下如尖瓦片； 它如钉耙经过淤泥。

zhTraditional.text: 牠肚腹下如尖瓦片； 牠如釘耙經過淤泥。

en.text: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

zhSimplified.text: 它使深渊开滚如锅， 使洋海如锅中的膏油。

zhTraditional.text: 牠使深淵開滾如鍋， 使洋海如鍋中的膏油。

en.text: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

zhSimplified.text: 它行的路随后发光， 令人想深渊如同白发。

zhTraditional.text: 牠行的路隨後發光， 令人想深淵如同白髮。

en.text: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

zhSimplified.text: 在地上没有像它造的那样， 无所惧怕。

zhTraditional.text: 在地上沒有像牠造的那樣， 無所懼怕。

en.text: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

zhSimplified.text: 凡高大的，它无不藐视； 它在骄傲的水族上作王。

zhTraditional.text: 凡高大的，牠無不藐視； 牠在驕傲的水族上作王。
